title: Leftover Text Check
description: Stops text being published with the parts nobody meant to keep: chatbot chatter and refusals ("I cannot fulfill that request"), unfilled placeholders ([product], [task 1], XX%), TK and TODO markers and a paragraph pasted twice, with no false alarms on [1], [sic] or Markdown links, flagging them the moment they are pasted, deleting a chatter sentence in one tap, filling every copy of a placeholder at once, and asking for a second press to publish with leftovers.
